recall_additions.basis: YC's own /companies/convoy page, batch_name ycc_only, id 11874, Seattle, founded 2015 — the digital-freight company YC Continuity led a $62M Series B into on 2017-07-25, reported at the time as the first stake YC took in a later-stage company it had not previously funded. It is one of exactly two ycc_only rows and is invisible to the public search index. It entered the base late because companies.json had been generated before this row was added to the unindexed source, so the site merge never saw it. DISTINCT from the directory's own 'Convoy' (slug convoy-2, Winter 2022, getconvoy.io, an open-source webhooks company). Slug is `convoy-continuity`, deliberately NOT convoy-2: the directory's own site_id `convoy-2` belongs to the Winter 2022 webhooks company, and a base slug colliding with a directory site_id makes every by-slug evidence lookup return the wrong company — it already fed one judging pass the wrong metadata.

openai.basis: Erik's ruling, 2026-09-16: 'If OpenAI did not receive investment from a YC entity, keep out.' Verified: at its December 2015 founding OpenAI was a non-profit funded by contributions from Altman, Brockman, Musk, Livingston, Thiel, AWS, Infosys and YC Research (TechCrunch, 2015-12-11: 'The organization is being funded by ... and YC Research'; 'Those funders have contributed $1 billion'). YC Research was a non-profit research lab that Sam Altman jump-started with $10M of his own money, which YC's own post said was 'not ... with the goal of helping YC's startups succeed or adding to our bottom line'; it is none of YC's 20 address-verified fund vehicles and none of the 19 funds in YC Management's ADV. A donation by a separately funded non-profit lab to a non-profit is not an investment by a YC entity, and no YC fund appears in any later OpenAI financing (Microsoft 2019 and 2023; the Oct 2024 round; the 2025 SoftBank-led round with Thrive, Coatue and Altimeter). YC's archived company page for OpenAI therefore reflects affiliation, not fund money, and does not carry membership. Supersedes the run's agent verdict of 2026-09-07.
